supersessions.what: George Kurian (BJP) ceased to be Minister of State for Minority Affairs and for Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying; his resignation was accepted by President Droupadi Murmu after he was not re-nominated to the Rajya Sabha.
Ravneet Singh Bittu (BJP) resigned as Minister of State for Railways and for Food Processing Industries after his Rajya Sabha term from Rajasthan ended; resignation accepted by the President.
Dharmendra Pradhan (BJP) resigned as Minister of Education; Pralhad Joshi was given additional charge of the Ministry of Education.

Sanghi Industries Ltd — Delisted / merged: Acquired by Ambuja Cements in 2023. NCLT Ahmedabad approved amalgamation into Ambuja Cements on 9 February 2026; merger effective 12 March 2026; shares delisted and trading suspended on NSE and BSE from 6 April 2026. No longer a separate listed entity.
src: Angel One — Ambuja/Sanghi merger effective after NCLT approval

supersessions.what: AWL Agri Business Ltd (formerly Adani Wilmar Ltd) — Sold — no longer an Adani group company: Adani exited the edible-oil/FMCG joint venture in stages: 13.5% sold January 2025, 20% sold to Wilmar International July 2025, and the residual ~7% sold via block deal on 20 November 2025, completing a full exit. Wilmar International is now the sole promoter with a reported ~57% stake; the company was renamed AWL Agri Business Ltd. Screener's page still carries stale text describing Adani entities as promoters — the 56.94% promoter figure it shows for Jun 2026 is Wilmar's, NOT Adani's. Adani promoter holding is therefore recorded as null/zero here. mcapCr retained for reference only and is NOT included in the Adani combinedMcapCr.
src: Business Standard — Adani to sell entire AWL Agri stake to Wilmar

absences.what: Rajya Sabha members have no territorial constituency; 'constituency' is null for all 10 Rajya Sabha ministers and 'state' records the state they represent.

'since' is set to 2024-06-10 (the date portfolios were allocated for the third Modi ministry) for all ministers other than the Prime Minister (2024-06-09); the exact date each individual portfolio was assumed was not separately verified where a minister holds multiple ministries.
Pralhad Joshi's 'since' of 2024-06-10 covers Consumer Affairs and New & Renewable Energy only; his charge of the Ministry of Education dates from 2026-07-25 (flagged in his notes).
'priorPortfolios' is best-effort from Wikipedia infoboxes and is not exhaustive; it is empty for ministers with no verifiable earlier union portfolio.
cabinet.gov.in and india.gov.in could not be scraped (HTTP 503 / JavaScript-rendered), so the official cross-check relies on pmindia.gov.in's portfolio allocation page (last updated 25 July 2026).

Three former members of this ministry (Dharmendra Pradhan, George Kurian, Ravneet Singh Bittu) are excluded from 'ministers' as they are no longer in the council; their departures are recorded in 'changesSince2024'.

As of 2026-08-11 no successor had been appointed to the vacated Minister of State posts (Minority Affairs; Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying; Railways; Food Processing Industries) beyond Pralhad Joshi's additional charge of Education.
Arunachal Pradesh: No NSE/BSE-listed company maintains a registered office in the state; the economy is dominated by hydropower projects owned by central/state PSUs registered elsewhere.
Manipur: No listed company has a registered office in the state; largest employers are state undertakings and central PSU units.
Mizoram: No NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; economy is agriculture and government services.
Nagaland: No NSE/BSE-listed registered offices.
Tripura: No NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; ONGC Tripura Power Company is unlisted.
Sikkim: StockMagnets records zero NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; pharma plants in Sikkim (Sun, Cipla, Alkem, Zydus, IPCA) belong to companies registered in Maharashtra/Gujarat.
Puducherry: No NSE/BSE-listed company registered in the UT; industrial units at Puducherry belong to Tamil Nadu- and Maharashtra-registered parents.
Andaman and Nicobar Islands: No listed registered offices; economy is tourism, fisheries and defence.
Lakshadweep: No listed registered offices.
Daman and Diu: Now merged with Dadra & Nagar Haveli into a single UT; listed registered offices in the merged UT cluster at Silvassa and are recorded under stateCode 'dn'.

BSE scrip codes: filled only where confidently known. Codes for TMPV, TMCV, JSWCEMENT, ABLBL, VAML, VOGL, VISL and VEDPOWER are null — these are recent listings and the codes were not verified against an exchange source.

listedYear: null for most entities. Only listing years explicitly stated by a source are recorded (JIOFIN 2023, JSWINFRA 2023, BAJAJHFL 2024, TMPV/TMCV 2025, JSWCEMENT 2025, VAML/VOGL/VISL/VEDPOWER 2026).

Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd: the full current cap table could not be verified. Only individually sourced stakes (KKR 1.42%, QIA ~1%, ADIA 0.59%) are recorded; the 2020-round investors Silver Lake, GIC, TPG, General Atlantic, Mubadala and PIF are named without percentages.
Jio Platforms cap-table percentages come from press coverage of a filing rather than the filing itself. RIL's own stake is recorded at 66.43% from the same coverage.

IHC's current shareholding in Adani Enterprises is NOT verified as of 2026-08-11. The 5.04% figure is from an October 2023 disclosure; IHC's exits from Adani Green and Adani Transmission are recorded but the residual position is unconfirmed.
TotalEnergies' current stake in Adani Green Energy is unsettled: 17.25% after Q4 2025 block deals, with further sales reported as planned. ATGL's 37.4% is as of March 2026.
Vedanta Power Ltd (VEDPOWER): market cap is as of 29 July 2026, not 11 August 2026, and promoter holding is null — the Screener page for this ticker returned 404.
